_comment: Row 722 live (members.filthykings.com, 2026-09-15T06:25:59Z): the window.open grant is a host-relative href ('/movieaction/download/<id>/2160p/mp4?...'); the grant reader must resolve it against page.url before the HTTP leg scores provenance. M1 drops the urljoin so the raw attribute reaches staging_claim.resource_identity again and the live 'cannot derive resource provenance ... no scheme or host' refusal returns. M2 (session scope) intentionally absent: the jar was measured (14 of 17 cookies are .filthykings.com domain cookies and DO cover members; the 2 login-host cookies are host-only for www) so session_scope's diagnostic is correct and nothing was changed there.
subject: bulk_downloader/runner_transport.py
